zones.label: Upper Face (Forehead, Brows & Eyes)
zones.description: Includes the forehead, eyebrows, glabella, upper/lower eyelids, and infraorbital triangle (cheeks). Upper-face micro-expressions are common when someone holds a social smile in the lower face.

zones.label: Middle Face (Nasal Bridge, Infraorbital Cheeks & Upper Nasolabial)
zones.description: Bridges the lower eyelids, cheekbones, nasal bridge, nostrils, and upper lip. Key zone for distinguishing disgust (AU9+10) and Duchenne cheek elevation (AU6).

zones.label: Lower Face (Lips, Mouth Corners, Chin & Jaw)
zones.description: Includes the orbicularis oris ring, lip corners, buccinator, risorius, depressors, mentalis chin boss, and mandible. Easily controlled voluntarily for social masking, yet rich in tension cues.

muscles.name: Frontalis (Medial & Lateral)
muscles.function: Lifts the eyebrows upward and wrinkles the forehead horizontally. Medial fibers produce AU1 (inner brow raise); lateral fibers produce AU2 (outer brow raise).

muscles.name: Corrugator Supercilii
muscles.function: Draws the eyebrows downward and medially together, creating vertical glabella furrows ('11 lines') between the brows.

muscles.name: Procerus & Depressor Supercilii
muscles.function: Pulls the skin between the eyebrows straight down toward the root of the nose, creating horizontal creases across the nasal root.

muscles.name: Orbicularis Oculi (Orbital & Palpebral)
muscles.function: Sphincter muscle encircling the eye. Outer orbital fibers raise the cheek and crinkle crow's feet (AU6); inner palpebral fibers tighten the eyelids (AU7).

muscles.name: Levator Labii Superioris (& Alaeque Nasi)
muscles.function: Medial slip wrinkles the sides of the nose and flares nostrils (AU9); main belly lifts the upper lip into a squared arch and deepens the upper nasolabial furrow (AU10).

muscles.name: Zygomaticus Major
muscles.function: Runs from the cheekbone (zygomatic arch) to the mouth corner, pulling the lip corners upward and obliquely back in a smile (AU12).

muscles.name: Risorius (& Platysma)
muscles.function: Pulls the mouth corners horizontally backward toward the ears (AU20), stretching and flattening the lips in fear.

muscles.name: Buccinator
muscles.function: Compresses the cheek against the teeth and tightens the mouth corner inward (AU14 dimpler). Unilateral contraction defines contempt.

muscles.name: Orbicularis Oris
muscles.function: Encircles the mouth opening. Marginal fibers narrow and roll the red lip inward (AU23); labial fibers press the lips firmly together (AU24).

muscles.name: Depressor Anguli Oris & Depressor Labii Inferioris
muscles.function: Depressor anguli oris pulls the mouth corners down in sadness (AU15); depressor labii inferioris pulls the lower lip down and out (AU16).

muscles.name: Mentalis
muscles.function: Elevates and wrinkles the skin of the chin boss, pushing the lower lip upward into an inverted pout (AU17) in sadness or skepticism.

wrinkles.name: Horizontal Forehead Lines
wrinkles.description: Long curved horizontal furrows across the entire forehead when AU1 + AU2 fire together (surprise), or short central horizontal lines when AU1 fires alone or with AU4 (sadness/fear).

wrinkles.name: Vertical Glabella Lines ('Eleven Lines')
wrinkles.description: One or two deep vertical furrows between the inner eyebrows caused by medial brow pulling in anger, fear, and sadness.

wrinkles.name: Crow's Feet (Lateral Orbital Lines)
wrinkles.description: Fan-shaped lines radiating outward from the outer eye corners when the cheek raiser (AU6) contracts in a genuine Duchenne smile or pain.

wrinkles.name: Nasal Bridge Wrinkles ('Bunny Lines')
wrinkles.description: Horizontal and diagonal creases across the bridge and sides of the nose characteristic of disgust (AU9).

wrinkles.name: Nasolabial Furrow
wrinkles.description: Runs from the nostril wings past the mouth corners. Deepens at the top in disgust (AU10, inverted-U shape) and curves outward/downward in smiling (AU12).

wrinkles.name: Mentalis Chin Dimpling ('Pebble Chin')
wrinkles.description: Pebbled dimpling on the chin boss accompanied by an arched lower lip when AU17 pushes the chin skin upward in sadness or doubt.

Tap the muscle that stretches the lips horizontally toward the ears in fear (AU20).
Tap the cheek muscle that tightens one mouth corner inward to create the unilateral dimple of contempt (AU14).
Tap the circular mouth muscle that tightens and presses the lips thin in anger (AU23 & AU24).
Tap the muscle group that pulls the lip corners downward in sadness (AU15).
Tap the chin muscle that pushes the lower lip up and dimples the chin boss (AU17).
